# agyn_agent (Resource)

Manages an Agyn agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_agent" "example" {
  title         = "My Agent"
  description   = "An example agent managed by Terraform."
  name          = "my-agent"
  role          = "assistant"
  model         = "gpt-4o"
  system_prompt = "Assist with workspace automation."
  when_busy     = "wait"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config` (String, Deprecated) Deprecated JSON-encoded agent configuration. Use structured attributes instead.
- `debounce_ms` (Number) Debounce duration in milliseconds.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the agent.
- `model` (String) Model identifier override for the agent.
- `name` (String) Agent name for the configuration.
- `process_buffer` (String) Processing strategy for buffered content (allTogether or oneByOne).
- `restrict_output` (Boolean) Whether to enforce output restrictions.
- `restriction_max_injections` (Number) Maximum number of restriction message injections.
- `restriction_message` (String) Message to inject when output restrictions are applied.
- `role` (String) Role assigned to the agent.
- `send_final_response_to_thread` (Boolean) Whether to send the final response to the thread.
- `summarization_keep_tokens` (Number) Number of tokens to keep during summarization.
- `summarization_max_tokens` (Number) Maximum number of tokens for summarization.
- `system_prompt` (String) System prompt override for the agent.
- `title` (String) Human-readable title of the agent.
- `when_busy` (String) Behavior when the agent is busy (injectAfterTools or wait).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the agent.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import agyn_agent.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
